subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to make the whole story. Only the corresponding
stimulus: numbers of the sentences need to be written. 1  8 = 8 (a) Therefore, they started to make friends with neighbouring groups so that they might fight with the others better. (b) Soon, however, they came to see that it was useful to have some friends to help them. (c) A tribe would not fight within itself, but quarrels went on between one tribe and another. (d) Think of the first human beings, living in small scattered groups, each made up of a few families. (e) Each, therefore, felt it necessary to grow larger and to be more powerful. (f) The members of each group would hunt together and also fight other groups over things they needed. (g) Then these friends came to live together and formed larger bodies called tribes. (h) So tribe began to join themselves together or were swallowed up by some larger tribes.
guide_solution: d → b → a → f → e → g → c → h Think of the first human beings, living in small scattered groups, each made up of a few families. Soon, however, they came to see that it was useful to have some friends to help them. Therefore, they started to make friends with neighbouring groups so that they might fight with the others better. The members of each group would hunt together and also fight other groups over things they needed. Each, therefore, felt it necessary to grow larger and to be more powerful. Then these friends came to live together and formed larger bodies called tribes. A tribe would not fight within itself, but quarrels went on between one tribe and another. So tribe began to join themselves together or were swallowed up by some larger tribes.
